lock.title: A chat is already in progress.
lock.description: You're already chatting with the Bigbird team on another screen. Please try again after that chat ends.

requestFailed: Couldn't request a chat. Please try again shortly.
sendFailed: Couldn't send the message. Please try again.
endFailed: Couldn't end the chat. Please try again.
cancelFailed: Couldn't cancel the request. Please try again.
notConnected: You can send messages after an agent connects.
lockLost: Another account is handling this chat.
lockCheckFailed: Couldn't check the chat status. We'll try again shortly.

advertiserWarning.title: Live chat auto-end
advertiserWarning.description: Live chat will end automatically if there are no new messages within 10 minutes

advertiserClosed.title: Live chat auto-end
advertiserClosed.description: Live chat ended automatically because there were no further messages

operatorDelay.title: Connecting to live chat
operatorDelay.description: Our agent is helping another customer, so replies are delayed. Please wait a moment

operatorUnavailable.title: Live chat delayed
operatorUnavailable.description: Our agents can't chat live right now. Leave a message and we'll reply soon.

hours.title: Live chat
hours.description: Live chat is available weekdays from 10 AM to 6 PM. Outside these hours, please leave a message.
